questions.question: How should the sensitive docs in docs/security/ be handled for the public sync?

options.label: Move to dstrader-secrets (Recommended)
options.description: Mirror ddoc#27's pattern: relocate HISTORY-AUDIT, HISTORY-REAUDIT, PROD-CUTOVER-RUNBOOK, PRE-PUBLIC-SECRETS-AUDIT, SWAP-PLAN, history-purge-paths.txt to dstrader-secrets. Leave a stub README in docs/security/ pointing readers to the companion. Aligns with CLAUDE.md guidance + lasts across future syncs.

options.label: sync-exclude.txt only
options.description: Add the six paths to the SOP's sync-exclude.txt mechanism so 6b's snapshot strips them. Lighter touch — docs stay in daily-driver clear. But CLAUDE.md says these belong in dstrader-secrets, so this leaves the inconsistency.

options.label: Split: short summary public, evidence ledger private
options.description: Keep a sanitized HISTORY-AUDIT-SUMMARY.md in the public repo (narrative only, no IDs/IPs/hostnames). Move the detailed evidence files to dstrader-secrets. More work but preserves the 'this repo had a scrub on date X' record for outside readers.

questions.question: And the cosmetic .DS_Store / .iml — clean up in the same PR?

options.label: Yes, both (Recommended)
options.description: git rm --cached dstrader/.DS_Store dstrader-docker.iml; add .DS_Store + *.iml to .gitignore. Trivial, professional-looking public repo.

options.label: Just .DS_Store
options.description: .iml is common in repos with IntelliJ users; leave it. Only clean the macOS Finder metadata.

options.label: Skip, just exclude from 6b
options.description: Don't touch the daily-driver; add both to sync-exclude.txt. Avoid churn on the private side.
